{
  "id": "kimura-neutral-theory-evo",
  "name": "Kimura Neutral Theory of Molecular Evolution",
  "description": "Motoo Kimura's revolutionary neutral theory: most evolutionary change at the molecular level is caused by random drift of selectively neutral mutations. Source: Kimura (1968). Nature. DOI: 10.1038/217624a0",
  "stocks": [
    {"id": "stock-neutral", "name": "Neutral_Mutations", "initial_value": 0, "equation": "", "position": {"x": 200, "y": 200}},
    {"id": "stock-fixed", "name": "Fixed_Mutations", "initial_value": 0, "equation": "", "position": {"x": 400, "y": 200}},
    {"id": "stock-lost", "name": "Lost_Mutations", "initial_value": 0, "equation": "", "position": {"x": 400, "y": 350}}
  ],
  "flows": [
    {"id": "flow-mutation", "name": "New_Mutations", "equation": "Mutation_Rate * Genome_Size", "from_stock": null, "to_stock": "stock-neutral", "position": {"x": 100, "y": 200}},
    {"id": "flow-fixation", "name": "Fixation_Rate", "equation": "Neutral_Mutations * Fixation_Probability", "from_stock": "stock-neutral", "to_stock": "stock-fixed", "position": {"x": 300, "y": 200}},
    {"id": "flow-loss", "name": "Loss_Rate", "equation": "Neutral_Mutations * (1 - Fixation_Probability)", "from_stock": "stock-neutral", "to_stock": "stock-lost", "position": {"x": 300, "y": 275}}
  ],
  "variables": [
    {"id": "var-mutation-rate", "name": "Mutation_Rate", "equation": "0.00000001", "position": {"x": 100, "y": 100}},
    {"id": "var-genome", "name": "Genome_Size", "equation": "3000000000", "position": {"x": 200, "y": 100}},
    {"id": "var-pop-size", "name": "Effective_Pop_Size", "equation": "10000", "position": {"x": 350, "y": 100}},
    {"id": "var-fix-prob", "name": "Fixation_Probability", "equation": "1 / (2 * Effective_Pop_Size)", "position": {"x": 450, "y": 100}},
    {"id": "var-sub-rate", "name": "Substitution_Rate", "equation": "Mutation_Rate", "position": {"x": 300, "y": 350}},
    {"id": "var-polymorphism", "name": "Expected_Polymorphism", "equation": "4 * Effective_Pop_Size * Mutation_Rate", "position": {"x": 150, "y": 350}},
    {"id": "var-molecular-clock", "name": "Molecular_Clock_Ticks", "equation": "Fixed_Mutations", "position": {"x": 500, "y": 200}}
  ],
  "connectors": [],
  "time_settings": {"start": 0, "end": 1000000, "dt": 1000},
  "created_at": "2026-01-15T00:00:00Z",
  "updated_at": "2026-01-15T00:00:00Z",
  "source": "https://doi.org/10.1038/217624a0",
  "reference": "Kimura, M. (1968). Evolutionary rate at the molecular level. Nature, 217, 624-626."
}

{
  "id": "wright-fisher-genetic-drift-evo",
  "name": "Wright-Fisher Genetic Drift Model",
  "description": "Classic population genetics model of random genetic drift in finite populations. Allele frequencies change stochastically each generation. Foundation of neutral theory. Source: Wright (1931), Fisher (1930). DOI: 10.1093/genetics/16.2.97",
  "stocks": [
    {"id": "stock-freq", "name": "Allele_Frequency", "initial_value": 0.5, "equation": "", "position": {"x": 300, "y": 200}},
    {"id": "stock-generations", "name": "Generations", "initial_value": 0, "equation": "", "position": {"x": 300, "y": 350}}
  ],
  "flows": [
    {"id": "flow-drift", "name": "Frequency_Change", "equation": "Drift_Increment", "from_stock": null, "to_stock": "stock-freq", "position": {"x": 150, "y": 200}},
    {"id": "flow-gen", "name": "Generation_Increment", "equation": "1", "from_stock": null, "to_stock": "stock-generations", "position": {"x": 150, "y": 350}}
  ],
  "variables": [
    {"id": "var-pop-size", "name": "Population_Size", "equation": "100", "position": {"x": 150, "y": 100}},
    {"id": "var-drift-sd", "name": "Drift_SD", "equation": "SQRT(Allele_Frequency * (1 - Allele_Frequency) / (2 * Population_Size))", "position": {"x": 350, "y": 100}},
    {"id": "var-drift-inc", "name": "Drift_Increment", "equation": "Drift_SD * (2 * RANDOM() - 1) * 1.7", "position": {"x": 200, "y": 300}},
    {"id": "var-het", "name": "Heterozygosity", "equation": "2 * Allele_Frequency * (1 - Allele_Frequency)", "position": {"x": 450, "y": 200}},
    {"id": "var-fixation", "name": "Near_Fixation", "equation": "IF(Allele_Frequency > 0.95 OR Allele_Frequency < 0.05, 1, 0)", "position": {"x": 450, "y": 350}},
    {"id": "var-ne", "name": "Effective_Population_Size", "equation": "Population_Size", "position": {"x": 100, "y": 300}}
  ],
  "connectors": [],
  "time_settings": {"start": 0, "end": 200, "dt": 1},
  "created_at": "2026-01-15T00:00:00Z",
  "updated_at": "2026-01-15T00:00:00Z",
  "source": "https://doi.org/10.1093/genetics/16.2.97",
  "reference": "Wright, S. (1931). Evolution in Mendelian populations. Genetics, 16(2), 97-159."
}

{
  "id": "ransomware-cyber-threat-tec",
  "name": "Ransomware Cyber Threat Ecosystem Model",
  "description": "Models the dynamics of ransomware attacks including attack frequency, ransom payments, defensive investments, and the ransomware-as-a-service ecosystem. Based on cybersecurity incident data and threat intelligence.",
  "source": "https://www.cisa.gov/stopransomware/ransomware-guide",
  "reference": "CISA, MS-ISAC, NSA and FBI. #StopRansomware Guide. September 2023; updates the CISA/MS-ISAC September 2020 guide. Prevention and response guidance only, not a source of the local attack, revenue or capability equations.",
  "stocks": [
    {"id": "stock-vulnerable-orgs", "name": "Vulnerable Organizations", "initial_value": 500000, "equation": "", "position": {"x": 100, "y": 150}},
    {"id": "stock-protected-orgs", "name": "Protected Organizations", "initial_value": 100000, "equation": "", "position": {"x": 100, "y": 300}},
    {"id": "stock-compromised", "name": "Compromised Organizations", "initial_value": 1000, "equation": "", "position": {"x": 300, "y": 150}},
    {"id": "stock-ransomware-revenue", "name": "Ransomware Revenue", "initial_value": 500000000, "equation": "", "position": {"x": 500, "y": 150}},
    {"id": "stock-attacker-capability", "name": "Attacker Capability", "initial_value": 100, "equation": "", "position": {"x": 500, "y": 300}}
  ],
  "flows": [
    {"id": "flow-attacks", "name": "Successful Attacks", "equation": "Vulnerable_Organizations * Attack_Rate * Attacker_Capability / 100", "from_stock": "stock-vulnerable-orgs", "to_stock": "stock-compromised", "position": {"x": 200, "y": 150}},
    {"id": "flow-recovery", "name": "Recovery", "equation": "Compromised_Organizations / Recovery_Time", "from_stock": "stock-compromised", "to_stock": "stock-vulnerable-orgs", "position": {"x": 200, "y": 200}},
    {"id": "flow-hardening", "name": "Security Hardening", "equation": "Vulnerable_Organizations * Hardening_Rate * Defense_Investment_Effect", "from_stock": "stock-vulnerable-orgs", "to_stock": "stock-protected-orgs", "position": {"x": 100, "y": 225}},
    {"id": "flow-ransom-payments", "name": "Ransom Payments", "equation": "Compromised_Organizations * Payment_Rate * Average_Ransom", "from_stock": null, "to_stock": "stock-ransomware-revenue", "position": {"x": 400, "y": 150}},
    {"id": "flow-capability-growth", "name": "Capability Growth", "equation": "Ransomware_Revenue * Reinvestment_Rate / 10000000", "from_stock": null, "to_stock": "stock-attacker-capability", "position": {"x": 500, "y": 225}}
  ],
  "variables": [
    {"id": "var-attack-rate", "name": "Attack_Rate", "equation": "0.001", "position": {"x": 200, "y": 100}},
    {"id": "var-recovery-time", "name": "Recovery_Time", "equation": "4", "position": {"x": 250, "y": 200}},
    {"id": "var-hardening", "name": "Hardening_Rate", "equation": "0.002", "position": {"x": 50, "y": 225}},
    {"id": "var-defense-effect", "name": "Defense_Investment_Effect", "equation": "1", "position": {"x": 175, "y": 300}},
    {"id": "var-payment-rate", "name": "Payment_Rate", "equation": "0.4", "position": {"x": 350, "y": 100}},
    {"id": "var-avg-ransom", "name": "Average_Ransom", "equation": "250000", "position": {"x": 450, "y": 100}},
    {"id": "var-reinvestment", "name": "Reinvestment_Rate", "equation": "0.3", "position": {"x": 600, "y": 225}}
  ],
  "connectors": [],
  "time_settings": {"start": 0, "end": 120, "dt": 1},
  "created_at": "2026-01-15T21:00:00.000000+00:00",
  "updated_at": "2026-01-15T21:00:00.000000+00:00"
}
